title: Who a Rule Applies To
goal: Say who a rule applies to with quien, toda persona que and los socios que + subjunctive, and tell it from a statement about a real group.

items: I can say who a rule applies to with *quien*, *cualquier socio que* and *las personas que* + subjunctive.
I can tell a rule for anyone (subjunctive) from a statement about a real group (indicative).
I can use *inscribirse*, *el solicitante* and *incumplir* to talk about entry and compliance.
